title: Spinal Dural Arteriovenous Fistula International Data and Outcomes Registry
official: SPIDER - Spinal Dural Arteriovenous Fistula International Data and Outcomes Registry
summary: Given the lack of large multicenter datasets in the context of Spinal arteriovenous fistula, the strength of the evidence surrounding this rare disease is limited. SPIDER hence aims to address that by compiling patient-level data from centers all around the world.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 1 spinal dural arteriovenous fistula, confirmed on imaging
* Surgically or endovascularly treated
* At least 1 available primary outcome
